ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75% high-intensity (off-white and yellowish-brown) pixels to 25% low-intensity (black) pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity pixels form the primary mass of both lobes, containing significant yellowish-brown mottling throughout. Low-intensity pixels are concentrated in a continuous band along the trailing edge and form a triangular cluster at the point of peduncle insertion.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 72 degrees; vertex is sharply defined.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Trailing edge exhibits a high frequency of low-amplitude serrations; irregular jaggedness is more pronounced on the distal end of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges exhibit a strong concave curvature from the median notch to the lobe tips; tips are tapered and slightly rounded.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Extensive distribution of irregular, circular, and semi-circular brownish-orange pixel clusters across 60% of the visible fluke surface, predominantly in the medial regions.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible yellowish-brown surface staining covering the majority of the high-intensity areas on both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: High-contrast black border along the entire trailing edge creates a distinct silhouette against the marine background.
